item.title: Bei ya mafuta yapanda, masoko ya hisa yachanganyika kutokana na sintofahamu ya vita vya Iran - Mwanzo TV
item.description: Bei ya mafuta imepanda huku masoko ya hisa yakionyesha mwelekeo tofauti leo Jumanne, kutokana na kutokuwa na uhakika kuhusu hatma ya vita vya Mashariki ya Kati .

item.title: Five Children Killed in Sudan's South Kordofan, Says Unicef - Mwanzo TV
item.description: "This weekend, five children were reportedly killed and three more injured in Dilling, South Kordofan," the UN children's agency wrote on its X account.

item.title: China and Pakistan Outline Five-Point Plan to End Mideast War - Mwanzo TV
item.description: Pakistani Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar met his Chinese counterpart Wang Yi and agreed to "strengthen strategic communication and coordination on the Iran situation and ... make new efforts towards advocating for peace", Beijing said.

item.title: Iran Confirms Killing of General Sanctioned by US Over Oil Network - Mwanzo TV
item.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards on Tuesday confirmed the killing in a US-Israeli airstrike of a brigadier general sanctioned by the US in 2025 over an international network shipping oil to China and using profits to fund Tehran-backed regional proxies.

item.title: Colombia Intelligence Boss Resigns After Leaks Scandal - Mwanzo TV
item.description: Wilmar Mejia, a senior official at the National Intelligence Directorate (DNI), was accused of leaking information that benefited a FARC dissident faction, according to reporting by Caracol TV in November that cited seized chats and documents.

item.title: National Bank of Kuwait Shuts Headquarters Amid Iran Attacks - Mwanzo TV
item.description: Tehran has threatened to target vital infrastructure across the Gulf, including energy sites.

item.title: 'Dozens' Killed in Burundi After Arsenal fire: Security Sources - Mwanzo TV
item.description: The explosions began at the main ammunition depot of the Burundi National Defence Force (FDNB) in Musaga, in the southern suburbs of Bujumbura, the country’s economic hub.

item.title: Pan-African Activists decry deteriorating human rights situation in Tanzania and Uganda - Mwanzo TV
item.description: The Pan-African Solidarity Network has condemned the deteriorating human rights situation in Tanzania and Uganda, calling for the immediate release of political prisoners and an end to state-sponsored violence.

item.title: DR Congo yafuzu kushiriki kombe la dunia - Mwanzo TV
item.description: Timu ya taifa ya mchezo wa soka ya Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Congo, imefuzu kwenye fainali ya kombe la dunia, kwa mara ya kwanza, baada ya miaka 52, baada ya kuifunga Jamaica bao 1-0.

item.title: Ongezeko bei ya mafuta lachochea hofu ya mfumuko wa bei - Mwanzo TV
item.description: Ongezeko hili kubwa zaidi ya asilimia 33 kwa petroli na dizeli ndani ya mwezi mmoja linatokana na mzozo unaoendelea Mashariki ya Kati, kati ya Marekani, Israel na Iran, ulioonza tangu Februari 28, 2026.
